reply.v16_title: v16: 30余因子枝における立方素数と prescribed base/cofactor の分離
reply.precise_candidate_claim: Let w,p,a,i,Q,r be natural numbers. Assume p is prime, 1 ≤ a, i = w * p^a + 2, 0 < Q, 0 < r, Q divides i * (i - 1), Q divides r^3, and Q does not divide r^2. Then there exists a prime q such that (q^3 divides i or q^3 divides i - 1) and (q = 2 or Nat.Coprime q (w * p)). Equivalently, the v15 cube obstruction in this branch is either the special prime 2 or an odd prime cube supported entirely outside the prescribed base p and the cofactor w.
reply.mathematical_argument_or_obstruction: Let w,p,a,i,Q,r be natural numbers with p prime, a≥1, i=w*p^a+2, Q>0, r>0, Q|i(i−1), Q|r^3, and Q∤r^2. The last condition is an explicit hypothesis taken from v15's written finite-Pell result; it is not proved in this module. From Q|r^3 and Q∤r^2, choose a prime q with v_q(Q)>2v_q(r). Since Q|r^3, v_q(Q)≤3v_q(r), so v_q(r)≥1 and v_q(Q)≥3; hence q^3|Q and q|r. Then q^3|i(i−1). Since i≥2 and gcd(i,i−1)=1, q^3|i or q^3|i−1. If q is odd and q|w*p, then q|w*p^a, so i≡2 mod q and i−1≡1 mod q, contradicting q^3|i or q^3|i−1. Thus q=2 or q∤w*p; for prime q the latter is Nat.Coprime q (w*p). This is only a separation: neither q=2 nor an odd prime cube outside w*p is excluded, and the branch is not closed. The cube-height inequalities give q≤κ and log i<28κ, hence κ>log i/28; they do not imply q>log i/28 or any lower bound on q beyond the trivial q≥2 (q≥3 for odd q). The neighbor-polynomial and v14 support observations are not used to strengthen the Lean conclusion.
reply.relation_to_original_problem: The frozen target thirty_cofactor_exclusion has exactly i = w*p^a + 2, p prime, a ≥ 1, w/gcd(w,6) ≤ 12, and the original squared-index equation in the ell=1, j=i-3 branch. Any counterexample therefore satisfies the hypotheses above. The new theorem forces the v15 cube factor to be either 2 or an odd prime cube coprime to w*p; it cannot be supplied by the prescribed base prime p or by a prime factor of the cofactor w. This is a new necessary condition on every remaining thirty-cofactor family. It does not exclude the families, does not solve the full equation, and does not change the fixed target type.
not_yet_proved: v15's Q ∤ r^2 is a written finite Pell result; it is not Lean-verified here and is used as a hypothesis.
The derivation of q^3 | Q and q | r from Q | r^3 and Q ∤ r^2 is not yet machine-checked; it is the first proposed Lean goal.
The case q = 2 is not excluded; new odd prime cubes outside w*p are not excluded.
The full thirty_cofactor_exclusion and the full four-variable equation remain open.
The proposed Lean module has not been run; no PASS or kernel verification is claimed.
reply.checkpoint_summary: v15の16ファイルとmanifestを確認。v15は n²+2 の合成性、Q∤r²、κ≥2 と log n<28κ、候補数 O(√X log X) などを与えるが、記述証明と有限計算でありLean未検証。既存Leanは52定理・15モジュールPASS、CFVerifierBridgeまで保存済み。v16では30余因子枝 i=w p^a+2 にv15の立方因子障害を接続する。Q|r³かつQ∤r²から素数qで q³|Q, q|r を得る。Q|i(i-1)とgcd(i,i-1)=1から q³|i または q³|i-1。qが奇素数で q|w*p なら i≡2, i-1≡1 mod q となり矛盾。よって q=2 または gcd(q,w*p)=1。これは固定目標 thirty_cofactor_exclusion の反例が持つ立方因子を、指定素数pとcofactor wの外へ追い出す新しい必要条件。完全排除ではない。次はこの分離定理をLeanで検証する。

theorem odd_prime_cube_not_dvd_shift (X i q : ℕ) (hX : i = X + 2) (hq : Nat.Prime q) (hq2 : q ≠ 2) (hcube : q ^ 3 ∣ i ∨ q ^ 3 ∣ i - 1) : ¬ q ∣ X

theorem thirty_cofactor_cube_prime_separation (w p a i Q r : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hi : i = w * p ^ a + 2) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hr : 0 < r) (hQdiv : Q ∣ i * (i - 1)) (hdiv3 : Q ∣ r ^ 3) (hnot2 : ¬ Q ∣ r ^ 2) : ∃ q : ℕ, Nat.Prime q ∧ (q = 2 ∨ Nat.Coprime q (w * p)) ∧ (q ^ 3 ∣ i ∨ q ^ 3 ∣ i - 1)
